purpose: Select and MultiSelect: a searchable combobox for one or many values, with options in the browser's top layer, optional virtualisation and create-on-type.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Offers "Create …" when the search matches no option.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the control when there is no visible `label`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show the clear button. Default true.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the list after choosing. Default true; `false` keeps it open.

props.name: description
props.description: A hint under the label, linked as the control's description.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches the search. Defaults to the locale text.

props.name: error
props.description: Message shown below the control; also marks the control invalid.

props.name: filterFn
props.description:
Replaces the built-in search matching (client mode).
`NoInfer` keeps the option type coming from `options` and `value` only.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: More results are available; the list calls `onLoadMore` when scrolled near the end.

props.name: label
props.description: The control's name, shown above it and linked to it.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading row; keeps current options visible.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of selections.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the option list in pixels. Default 280.

props.name: maxVisibleTags
props.description: Tags shown before collapsing into "+N more". Default 3.

props.name: mode
props.description: `client` filters `options` locally; `server` expects `options` to be the current results.
props.note: Single or multiple. Changing it changes the shape of `value`, so it cannot be toggled on a live field.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the hidden form input.

props.name: onChange
props.signature: ((value: NoInfer<V> | null, option: ComboboxOption<NoInfer<V>> | null) => void) | undefined
props.description:
The chosen value, and the whole option beside it so the label and
anything else it carries need not be looked up again. Both are
`null` once the control is cleared.

props.name: onCreate
props.description:
The text someone typed when they chose "Create ...". Adding it to
`options` and selecting it is yours to do.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description:
Fetch the next page. Called once as the list nears its end, while
`hasMore` is true - so it must not fire again until the new options
have arrived.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The list opened or closed.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called with the search text (debounced in server mode), and on open.

props.name: options
props.description:
The choices. Each needs a `value` and a `label`, and may carry a
`description`, a `group` heading, an icon or `disabled`. In `server`
mode these are the current results rather than the whole set.

props.name: renderOption
props.description:
Draw each row yourself. `state` carries whether the option is
selected, active or disabled, so the row can reflect them.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show the search box. Default true. When false, typing jumps to a matching option.

props.name: searchDebounce
props.description: Debounce for `onSearchChange` in server mode. Default 250 ms.

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: Show "Select all" / "Clear all" under the list. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

props.name: virtualize
props.description: `true` / `false` to force, or a count above which virtualization turns on (default 80).
props.note: Worth turning on past a few hundred options; it changes nothing a user can observe.

events.name: onChange
events.signature: ((value: NoInfer<V> | null, option: ComboboxOption<NoInfer<V>> | null) => void) | undefined

supplied: the combobox pattern: aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant on the control
arrow keys move the active option, Enter selects, Escape closes and returns focus
the listbox renders in the top layer, so it is never clipped by an ancestor's overflow
the empty and loading states are announced rather than leaving silence
required: a `label`, or `aria-label` when the control is visually unlabelled
an `emptyMessage` that says what to do next, not just that nothing matched

composition.notes: Options come from the `options` array, not from children. `renderOption` changes how one is drawn but must not introduce its own focusable elements — the listbox owns focus.

setValue.summary: Write a value into the field, as though a person had entered it.

focus.summary: Move keyboard focus to the field.

open.summary: Open the field's calendar or option list.

close.summary: Close the field's calendar or option list.

safeMutations.rationale: Presentation and affordances are safe. `options` is the domain, `mode` decides single or multiple, and `allowCreate` lets a user invent values the backend may not accept.
